exit_key.description: Unlocks the north exit. Kept until escape.

fuse.name: Ceramic Fuse
fuse.description: A single-use fuse for the kitchen electrical box. Install with E at the box.

crowbar.name: Crowbar

household_order.name: The Keeper's Instructions
household_order.description: A note from the living-room table. Enter to reread.
household_order.text:
I sealed the key before the footsteps returned. The dining lockbox holds my pry bar. Restore its power at the kitchen box; the spare fuse is in storage.

The four wheels follow this order: portraits, bells, cradles, chairs. The kitchen tally records what remains. Read each count as a single digit.

household_tally.name: Household Tally
household_tally.description: A kitchen drawer released when power returned. Enter to reread.
household_tally.text:
Inventory before the house fell silent:

Chairs: seven.
Cradles: one.
Portraits: two.
Bells: four.

The keeper wanted the counts in his order, never the order written here. The pry bar opens the boarded bedside cabinet in the second bedroom. Beyond its key lies the north exit.
